<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
.pmx-lb{--accent:#1f6f5c;--accent-soft:#e6f2ee;--accent-hover:#185a4a;--on-accent:#fff;--chip:#fff;--axis0:#c9c8c0;--halo:#fff;--na:#f1f1ee;--ink:#14181f;--ink-2:#4a5160;--ink-3:#626a78;--rule:#e2e2dc;--grid:#ecebe6;
 --sans:"Atkinson Hyperlegible",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
 --mono:"JetBrains Mono",SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
 color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
.pmx-lb *{box-sizing:border-box}
.pmx-lb h2{font-size:1.2rem;margin:0 0 6px;border:0;padding:0;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700}
.pmx-lb p{margin:0 0 12px}
.pmx-lb code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.85em;color:inherit;background:none;padding:0}
#title-block-header{display:none}
.pmx-lb .hero{background:var(--accent-soft);border-top:4px solid var(--accent);border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;padding:22px 24px 24px;margin:0 0 36px}
.pmx-lb .brand{font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 8px}
.pmx-lb h1{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:clamp(28px,4.6vw,40px);line-height:1.12;margin:0 0 10px;border:0;padding:0;text-wrap:balance}
.pmx-lb .lede{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:1.05rem;max-width:62ch}
.pmx-lb .facts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;font-size:.9rem}
.pmx-lb .facts li{background:var(--chip);border:1.5px solid var(--accent);color:var(--accent);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 12px}
.pmx-lb .facts b{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pmx-lb .take{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:10px}
.pmx-lb .take:hover{background:var(--accent-hover);color:var(--on-accent)}
.pmx-lb section{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:26px;margin-bottom:40px}
.pmx-lb .sub{color:var(--ink-2);font-size:.95rem;max-width:68ch}
.pmx-lb .flow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;align-items:start;gap:0 8px;color:var(--ink);max-width:720px;margin-top:18px}
.pmx-lb .step{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;min-width:0}
.pmx-lb .step .ic{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.pmx-lb .step .ic svg{height:60px;width:auto;display:block}
.pmx-lb .step .name{font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;margin-top:8px}
.pmx-lb .step .say{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ink-2);margin-top:4px;max-width:24ch;line-height:1.45}
.pmx-lb .arrow{width:48px;height:12px;margin-top:40px;color:var(--ink)}
.pmx-lb .tool{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--c);color:var(--cd);line-height:1.5;white-space:nowrap}
.pmx-lb .cfg{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.84rem}
.pmx-lb .sep{color:var(--ink-3)}
.pmx-lb .meta{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-3);font-weight:400}
.pmx-lb ol.dots{list-style:none;margin:16px 0 0;padding:0}
.pmx-lb .row,.pmx-lb .axis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px minmax(0,1fr) 64px;gap:0 20px;align-items:center}
.pmx-lb .row{padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid)}
.pmx-lb .lab{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:2px 8px;min-width:0}
.pmx-lb .track{padding:0 6px}
.pmx-lb .track svg{display:block}
.pmx-lb .track .g{stroke:var(--grid);stroke-width:1}
.pmx-lb .track .g:first-child{stroke:var(--axis0)}
.pmx-lb .track .run{stroke:var(--halo);stroke-width:1.5;fill-opacity:.9}
.pmx-lb .track .mean{stroke:var(--cd)}
.pmx-lb .val{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pmx-lb .axis{margin-top:6px}
.pmx-lb .axis svg text{font:11px var(--sans);fill:var(--ink-3)}
.pmx-lb .axis .cap{grid-column:2;text-align:center;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-3)}
.pmx-lb .cols{list-style:none;margin:16px 0 18px;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.pmx-lb .cols li{font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink-2);border-top:2px solid var(--ink);padding-top:8px}
.pmx-lb .cols li b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:2px}
.pmx-lb .legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:12px var(--mono);color:var(--ink-3);margin-bottom:10px}
.pmx-lb .legend .bar{display:flex;width:200px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.pmx-lb .legend .bar span{flex:1}
.pmx-lb .scroll{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.pmx-lb table.heat{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:4px;min-width:720px;width:100%;margin:0;font-size:.9rem}
.pmx-lb table.heat th,.pmx-lb table.heat td{border:0;padding:0}
.pmx-lb table.heat thead th{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;text-align:center;padding:0 4px 6px;vertical-align:bottom}
.pmx-lb table.heat thead th:first-child{text-align:left}
.pmx-lb table.heat tbody th{text-align:left;font-weight:400;padding:6px 10px 6px 0;white-space:nowrap}
.pmx-lb table.heat tbody th .cfg{margin-left:8px}
.pmx-lb table.heat tbody th .meta{display:block}
.pmx-lb table.heat td{width:13%;height:42px;text-align:center;border-radius:4px;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pmx-lb table.heat td.na{background:var(--na);color:var(--ink-3);font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:400;font-size:.8rem}
.pmx-lb table.heat .ov{font-weight:800}
.pmx-lb .note{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-2);margin-top:14px;max-width:70ch}
body.quarto-dark .pmx-lb{--ink:#e7ebee;--ink-2:#b3bcc6;--ink-3:#959fa9;--rule:#444b52;--grid:#383e44;--accent:#5cc0a0;--accent-soft:#1d3d34;--accent-hover:#7fd3b7;--on-accent:#0c1f19;--chip:#222;--axis0:#5a6168;--halo:#222;--na:#33393f}
body.quarto-dark .pmx-lb .tool{color:var(--c)}
body.quarto-dark .pmx-lb .track .mean{stroke:var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:860px){.pmx-lb .cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media (max-width:720px){
 .pmx-lb .row,.pmx-lb .axis{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 52px;gap:4px 12px}
 .pmx-lb .lab{grid-column:1/-1}.pmx-lb .axis .spacer{display:none}.pmx-lb .axis .cap{grid-column:1}
 .pmx-lb .flow{gap:0 2px}.pmx-lb .step .ic svg{height:44px}.pmx-lb .step .ic{height:56px}
 .pmx-lb .arrow{width:24px;margin-top:30px}.pmx-lb .step .say{font-size:.8rem}
 .pmx-lb .cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<header class="hero"><p class="brand">PMxbench &middot; a pharmacometrics benchmark from the AIML-SIG</p><h1>Leaderboard</h1><p class="lede">Every scored attempt at a PMxbench scenario.
